# Shimmy Beauty Studio (Shimmyhands)

> Brow studio and handmade press-on nail brand in Singapore. Brows by Shimmyhands offers eyebrow embroidery, nano brows, ombre powder brows, microblading and lip blush. Nails by Shimmyhands sells handcrafted press-on nail sets.

Bookings and questions are handled on WhatsApp: +65 8930 8973 (https://wa.me/6589308973). Instagram: @shimmyhands.shop.
Studio hours: Monday–Friday 10:00–20:00, Saturday 10:00–18:00, Sunday by appointment.
